summary: Iteration 104 - Payroll Worksheet Extended Testing Complete. All requested features verified working: (1) Payroll worksheet save works end-to-end with success toast, (2) Print button is present and enabled, (3) Custom start/end date range works via date inputs, (4) Biweekly preset correctly expands worksheet to 14 rows with totals working, (5) Company settings payroll preferences (default_cycle=biweekly, pay_week_start_day=wednesday) save and persist, (6) Payroll summary/final total includes legacy manual pay correctly ($275.00 for 13.75 hrs), (7) Backend overtime/range calculations respect pay-week start day setting, (8) Legacy/signoff endpoints work with new range support.

critical_code_review_comments: Payroll.js correctly implements flexible date range selection with start/end date inputs
PayrollWorksheetToolbar.js provides Weekly, Biweekly, and Current Cycle preset buttons that respect tenant payroll settings
payrollWorksheet.js getCurrentCycleRange() correctly calculates biweekly (14 days) and weekly (7 days) ranges based on payWeekStartDay
PayrollWorksheetSummary.js correctly includes legacyManualHours and legacyManualPay in totals calculation
CompanySettings.js correctly saves and loads payroll_settings (default_cycle, pay_week_start_day)
Backend employees.py _get_pay_week_start() correctly calculates pay week boundaries based on pay_week_start_day setting
Backend _summarize_entry_pay() correctly calculates overtime per pay week using pay_week_start_day
Backend signoff endpoints correctly support period_end parameter for flexible date ranges
Legacy manual entries section shows all required fields: date, source/type, hours, notes, current effect, handling mode, selected day, admin note
